description: The proposed works involve the replacement of a broken air conditioning unit with a new unit of nearly same size and specification, installed in the exact same location as the previous one. The property is powered solely by electricity, with no gas supply, which results in low internal temperatures during winter and high heat levels in summer. Effective climate control is therefore essential for the comfort of staff and customers, and for the continued operation of the business. The replacement air conditioning unit has been fully approved by the landlord. There is no change of use associated with this application.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed A1.0. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 2 - Within 1 month from the date of this decision the air conditioning units hereby approved shall be relocated to the new location shown on drawing A1.0 or removed. Photographic evidence of this relocation or removal shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residents in line with Policy LP2 of the Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 3 - The air conditioning units hereby authorized shall only be operated between the hours of 0700 and 1800 Monday to Sunday and shall be turned off at all other times. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residents in line with Policy LP2 of the Local Plan (2023).

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
